description: Fetch a URL and grade its HTTP security headers A-F: HSTS (with max-age), Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP. Also flags version-leaking headers (Server, X-Powered-By) and returns all response headers and the redirect chain.
name: security_headers
title: Grade a site's HTTP security headers
